terms.issue: Compulsory redundancy and plant closure exclusion
terms.outcome: Unresolved standoff between labour's unconditional veto and capital/state's demand for an evidence-based re-opener.
Agreed to mandate non-compulsory tools as the mandatory first-line response before any escalation.
Agreed to proportional contribution tied to total stakeholder cost, rejecting inverse scaling formulas.
Agreed to an 8-week jointly-scoped, independently audited modelling exercise with formal labour input.
Provisionally resolved in favor of sequenced pricing, though management retains methodological objections.
